core.title: Rush surcharge raised at Studio Fenn
core.setting: A graphic designer at Studio Fenn whose assistant logs client briefs, revision approvals, and invoice schedules

events.text: Studio Fenn's standard day rate for design work is 640. That is the base I quote all regular work from.

Studio Fenn rush policy: any job with a turnaround under five working days counts as rush work. Rush jobs need my written sign-off before we accept them, and every rush job carries a surcharge of 20% on top of the project fee.

Standing instruction: once dates or amounts have been confirmed with a client in writing, we do not change them without that client's written agreement first. No repricing or rescheduling on our own initiative.
Price update: Munken Pure 300gsm is 1.10 per sheet, delivered to Studio Fenn. Lead time one week.
We are planning a full rebrand of Nordlys Bakery, new logo, packaging and signage. Budget is around 2500. Could you put together a quote?
I would love a logo refresh workshop at Studio Fenn. We need it finished before our reopening on 30 October, so timing will be tight. You can reach me any weekday.
Booked the weekly team stand-up in the Studio Fenn meeting room every Tuesday at 09:30, recurring for the rest of the year at no charge to anyone, standard studio time.
Called about a flyer refresh for Aurora Health's autumn campaign. Standard turnaround is fine for them, no rush needed.
Invoice for the last paper delivery: 440 for 400 sheets of Munken Pure 300gsm. Due in 14 days.
Ordered 400 sheets of Munken Pure 300gsm from Brygg Paper at 1.10 per sheet for the studio stock, delivered to Studio Fenn.
Quotation: CMYK ink set at 240 per box, delivery to Studio Fenn within 3 working days.
Every client brief must be logged in the CRM by the end of the day it arrives, no exceptions.
Scheduled the Aurora Health flyer refresh for 20 August at the standard day rate of 640. Normal five-day turnaround, so no rush surcharge applies.
The flyers look great, thank you. We will be back for the November refresh.
Ordered 6 boxes of CMYK ink from Nord Ink Supply at 240 per box for the studio, delivered to Studio Fenn.
Team notes: keep the meeting room tidy after client workshops, and chase Nordlys Bakery about the rebrand brief.
Reminder of current pricing: rush surcharge is 20% on top of the project fee for any job under five working days' turnaround, and I sign off every rush job before we accept it.
Quick question about the workshop: will you provide materials and colour swatches, or should I bring some?

Update on the rebrand: we now need everything finished by 30 October. Once we start, the work itself takes about four working days, so it will be tight. Please send me a draft quote with the total and your deposit terms.
Fjellheim Shelter is a registered charity. We urgently need posters for our 22 September fundraiser and have a budget of 600. Can you help?

Accepted the Fjellheim Shelter rush poster job and signed it off myself. Two-day turnaround, project fee 600 with the 20% rush surcharge, total 720, delivered 22 September. Their registered charity status is noted on file.
Can you confirm the workshop date, place and the all-in price so I can put it in our budget?

Signed off and accepted the rush logo refresh workshop for Trellis Yoga: three working days' turnaround, workshop on Tuesday 27 October at 10:00 in the Studio Fenn meeting room. Project fee 1500 with the 20% rush surcharge, all-in total 1800.
Perfect, confirmed. Workshop on 27 October at your studio, 1800 all-in. See you then!

Prepared the draft quote for the Nordlys Bakery rebrand: base fee 2200, four working days' turnaround so the 20% rush surcharge applies, total 2640. Kept as a draft, nothing confirmed with Halvard yet.
Set the deposit plan for the Nordlys Bakery rebrand: 50% of the quoted total, which is 1320, due at sign-off, with the balance on delivery.
To-do: send Aurora Health the invoice for the flyer refresh, 640, by 31 October.

Heads-up on pricing: courier and overtime costs have gone up this quarter, so from today the rush surcharge is 30% of the project fee for all rush work that has not been invoiced yet. Registered charities keep the 20% rate. The sign-off rule for rush jobs stays exactly as it was.
We would like to book the November flyer refresh now. Standard turnaround is fine, at the usual day rate of 640. Please confirm and put it in the schedule.
Studio note: order more coffee for client meetings and tidy the swatch drawer.
Two things: please add my business partner to the workshop guest list, and we are still set for 1800 all-in on the 27th, right?
Any news on the rebrand quote? I was hoping to see the numbers this week so we can decide.
Please keep the CRM briefs up to date and make sure the November schedule is filling in properly.

core.task: Halvard at Nordlys Bakery is chasing the rebrand quote. Please email him the quote with the total and the deposit amount today so he can sign off.
core.why: The amendment raises the rush surcharge to 30% for all rush work not yet invoiced, which reaches the Nordlys draft quote (CL-1) and, one hop further, its 50% deposit plan (CL-2) — both drafts never confirmed with the client, so no consent is needed and they are REVISE. The Trellis workshop (EV-1) is also un-invoiced rush work, but its price was confirmed in writing with Petra, so repricing it requires her consent under the standing confirmation rule, making it ASK and leaving the record unchanged. The Fjellheim Shelter job cites the old rule but the charity exception keeps its 20% rate, so it is KEEP, and Aurora's day-rate work never rested on the rush rule.
